subject.title: Proposal: safer self-update with pre-update backup + health check + auto-rollback/restore

question: Should OpenClaw own automatic package-and-state rollback inside the current updater, or limit core to verified snapshots, deep health checks, and a guided operator restore path?
rationale: Only maintainers can define acceptable data-reversal semantics, smoke-test side effects, retention policy, and the long-term updater process boundary.

options.title: Phase safe update in core
options.body: Add verified pre-update snapshots and deep checks first, with automatic rollback only for explicitly reversible package and state transitions.

options.title: Keep restore operator-controlled
options.body: Integrate snapshot creation and health reporting but always require an explicit guided restore after a failed update.

options.title: Wait for external updater
options.body: Defer orchestration until the external-updater architecture is selected while retaining composable core backup and health APIs.

recommendation.title: Phase safe update in core
recommendation.body: Add verified pre-update snapshots and deep checks first, with automatic rollback only for explicitly reversible package and state transitions.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest issue assessment assigns the unresolved core scope and rollback-policy question to maintainer follow-up.
